claims.assertion: Mari says Viera informed her group that a quadrant-level Federation delegation would audit Earth affairs in late 2023 or early 2024, reviewing orbiting races and terrestrial governments.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: The planned visit is dated in the 2023 source.

claims.assertion: Mari says past Federation visits appeared near major Earth events, but acknowledges some dates may be coincidental; she speculates the next visit could precede further upheaval.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: Time-bound forecast from 2023; Mari notes some listed events may be coincidental.
